description: Keeps a save's driving side safe when left-hand traffic mods are switched on or off. The side of the road is a property of the save: the guard reads it from the roads already built (and remembers it with the game), and makes the streets and buildings built afterwards follow it, whichever mod, ours, another left-hand traffic mod or none, is on. It changes nothing else, and nothing in a save is rewritten. Needs the TF3OpenAPI native layer.
name: TF3OpenAPI save guard
